defs.def: a problem; a thing or situation that causes problems 困难；难题；难事；困境

ex.s: The project results from the difficulties many schools have in getting artists of any sort - whether an up-and-coming local musician or a major movie star - into schools to work with and inspire children.

ex.s: You will surely need to overcome some difficulties, some planned, but most unplanned.
ex.t: 你肯定需要克服一些困难，有些是计划内的，但大多数是计划外的。

ex.s: Make sure that you plan for these difficulties at the time of setting your goals.
ex.t: 确保你在设定目标时就为这些困难做好计划。

ex.t: 但即使在困难时期，也有办法保持健康的心理状态。

ex.t: 谈论这个女孩可能面临的其他困难并提出建议。

ex.s: She is determined to live a fulfilling life regardless of what the future holds, and to try her best to help patients with this cancer recover in spite of the various difficulties she might face.
ex.t: 她决心无论未来如何都要活得充实，并尽力帮助患这种癌症的病人康复，尽管可能面临各种困难。

ex.s: This might be in part because of the difficulties of defining and measuring kindness.

ex.s: AI also significantly enhances the educational value of museums, particularly for children and families. _____39_____ For instance, interactive exhibits powered by AI can adjust their content and difficulty level based on the user's preferences and responses.

ex.s: When asked why they chose so many AP classes, my friends responded: “I don’t know.” They themselves don’t know why they are following the crowd and longing for the pressures of academic difficulty.
ex.t: 当被问及为什么选择这么多AP课程时，我的朋友们回答说：“我不知道。”他们自己也不知道为什么要随大流，为什么渴望学业压力。
